title: Usage
description: Meters, usage per tenant and period, quotas and reservations.
noAccessBody: Your role does not include the permission “usage:read” for this product or tenant.

chart.summary: {{title}}: bar chart of daily usage from {{from}} to {{to}}. Total {{total}}, highest day {{max}}. The data table below lists every day.

totalsBy.sum: Sum of the daily values in the selected range.
totalsBy.max: Highest daily value in the selected range.
totalsBy.last: Value of the latest day with usage in the selected range.

overview.noMetersBody: Create a meter on the “Meters” tab. Usage is recorded by your product through the API.

meters.title: Meters
meters.description: What your product measures. Key, aggregation and reset period cannot change after creation.
meters.createDescription: Usage is recorded against the meter key through the API.
meters.editDescription: Name, unit, description and the default limit can be changed.
meters.keyHelp: Lowercase letters, digits, “_” and “.”, starting with a letter, e.g. api_calls.
meters.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits, “_” or “.”, starting with a letter (at most 63 characters).
meters.name: Name
meters.unitHelp: Shown next to values, e.g. calls or bytes.
meters.aggregationHelp: Sum adds events up, maximum keeps the highest value, last value keeps the newest.
meters.resetPeriodHelp: When the counter starts again. “Billing period” follows the tenant’s subscription.
meters.defaultLimitHelp: Leave empty for unlimited. Plans and tenant overrides take precedence.
meters.limitInvalid: Enter a number of 0 or more.
meters.enforcementHelp: Hard limits refuse usage above the limit; soft limits record it and report the excess.
meters.deleteBody: The meter {{key}} is removed. Meters with recorded usage cannot be deleted; deactivate them instead.
meters.emptyBody: Create a meter, then record usage for it from your product.

tenant.chooseBody: Select a tenant to see its usage, limits and events.
tenant.periodDescription: Per meter, with the effective limit and where it comes from.
tenant.periodAtHelp: Leave empty for the current period.

quota.title: Quota override for {{meter}}
quota.description: Replaces the plan and meter default limit for this tenant.
quota.limitHelp: Leave empty for no limit, even if the plan sets one.
quota.removeBody: The plan limit or the meter default applies again to {{meter}}.

events.title: Usage events
events.description: Recorded events, newest first. Events cannot be changed.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.description: The API has no list of reservations. Look one up by its id to see, commit or release it.
reservations.commitQuantityHelp: Leave empty to commit the reserved quantity.
reservations.releaseBody: The reserved quantity no longer counts against the limit. No usage is recorded.
reservations.readOnly: Committing or releasing needs the permission “usage:record”.

widget.title: Usage this month
widget.thisMonthNote: Totals since the first day of the month (UTC), across all tenants.
widget.sampled: Based on the first {{count}} tenant totals.

info.key: Your product records usage with this key, and plan entitlements refer to it as “limit.” followed by the key.
info.aggregation: Use Sum for things that add up, such as calls or messages. Use Maximum or Last value for a level you sample, such as stored bytes or seats.
info.resetPeriod: Periods have fixed boundaries in UTC: a daily limit is available again at midnight UTC, not 24 hours after the first use. “Billing period” uses calendar months while the tenant has no active subscription.
info.defaultLimit: Applies only to tenants without a quota override and without a plan limit for this meter. A change applies to the next recorded usage.
info.enforcement: With a hard limit, the API answers 429 “quota_exceeded” and records nothing. With a soft limit, usage is always recorded and marked as over the limit. Plan limits use the meter’s enforcement.
info.periodAt: Days are UTC days. Pick any date to see the period that contains it.
info.limitSource: The first match wins: tenant override, then the plan’s limit, then the meter default. Without any of them the meter is unlimited.
info.quotaLimit: The override replaces the plan and meter limit for this tenant until you remove it. Usage already recorded is not changed.
info.commit: A commit is never refused by the limit, because the work is already done. Expired reservations can no longer be committed.
